### Install

**Mac** (macOS 14 Sonoma or later, Apple Silicon or Intel)

1. Download **JBLControl-{VERSION}.dmg** below.
2. Open it and drag **JBLControl** onto **Applications** (choose **Replace** if you're updating).
3. First launch: if macOS blocks it, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/JBLControl.app`.
   **[Why this happens and why it's safe →](https://github.com/ffrafat/JBLControl#if-macos-blocks-jblcontrol)**

**Windows** (preview; Windows 10 version 1809 or later, x64 or Arm64)

1. Download **JBLControl-win-x64-{VERSION}-setup.exe** below (**win-arm64** for Arm PCs such as Snapdragon laptops).
2. Run it. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info → Run anyway**. Updating? Just run the new installer.
   **[Why this happens, and about Smart App Control →](https://github.com/ffrafat/JBLControl#if-windows-blocks-jblcontrol)**
3. Prefer no installer? Extract the portable **JBLControl-win-x64-{VERSION}.zip** and run `JBLControl.exe`.
